reviewItem.question: If an exposed environment does nothing about "`envoy_cilium_policymap_<node-ip>_<node-id>_update_time` -> `envoy_cilium_npds_update_time`", what happens, and is that review or action? proposed: behavior-change

consequence.statement: The metric is now exposed as envoy_cilium_npds_update_time rather than envoy_cilium_policymap_<node-ip>_<node-id>_update_time, so queries that use the old name stop matching.
consequence.remediation: Update dashboards, alerts and recording rules to use envoy_cilium_npds_update_time.

proposed.statement: In Cilium 1.17 the metric envoy_cilium_policymap_<node-ip>_<node-id>_update_time is renamed to envoy_cilium_npds_update_time, so monitoring that queries the old name has to be updated.
